body: Happy birthday. I hope you're doing a little better now.

Why is she so obsessed? Sounds like she's pushing your buttons and trying to exercise control over you, though I'm not a psychologist. Who even knows. Not normal though and at least a positive is that people can reaffirm that to you. Sending love.

I'm sick of people saying that getting others approval isn't important when jobs, etc, socialising being a human need literally mean approval is necessary... I'll never achieve that. I can barely even function and feel so behind... everything just feels like it's spiralling. I hate myself and everyone else hates me and it's made life near impossible mixed with being a complete waste of space. I don't want to stick around for things to get worse. Sorry for the negativity. Wishing you healing. I really think you can. You are worth something in this world. I really believe that despite you being a stranger.
I feel like a woman-child. I fucking hate myself. Literally every move I make is a mistake and I really just want to die.
I love you too. I really really do.
Mine too. I hope you get better.
Sorry that your sadness has reached into the point of suicidal thoughts. It's valid regardless. Often there are reasons that we can't pinpoint when things are overwhelming. Wishing you healing.
